📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-ms-scheduler-api-seriesid-negative-recordid`
This is occurrence #149 overall (first fire in ~17 days — longest dormancy on record for this entry). Degraded-mode alert (DD-scan-diff, no real Slack ts).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@crm experience` / n/a)
Playbook: Confirm shape via DD monitor 303750093 Alert state OR ES fields.dd_service.keyword:"ms-scheduler-api" + exceptions.Message.keyword signature. Root cause: SeriesDataProvider.GetSeriesIdAsync does not guard recordId=-1 before SqlDataReader.GetValue() — reproduces for ANY account passing the -1 sentinel, not account-specific. File/bump a defect for CRM Experience rather than re-diagnosing from scratch.
Open Jira: none
